verdict.rationale: dlt does not expose a standard OpenAPI spec — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json/well-known paths all returned 404 — but it does publish other machine-readable descriptors: an MCP server-card.json describing its tool surface, an agent-skills index.json, and an llms.txt file consumable by AI agents. These serve as partial 'equivalents' to an OpenAPI spec but are not a full, standards-based API spec covering the product's functionality. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/Swagger document, independent confirmation these MCP/agent-skill JSON files are comprehensive machine-readable API specs rather than narrow tool descriptors.
